name: net.fosa.avatar-texture-optimizer
description: The world's best VRChat avatar texture optimization tool. An open-source NDMF tool that analyzes meshes on avatars, builds UV-to-texture mappings, scales UV islands to a target quality tier, crops unused texture regions, and repacks islands into atlases to maximize texture utilization while preserving visual quality. (世界最好的 VRChat 贴图优化工具：基于 NDMF 的开源工具，分析网格建立 UV 与贴图映射，按质量挡位缩放 UV 岛、剔除未使用区域并重排图集，在保证质量的前提下最大化贴图利用率)
